description:
List all events from Holded CRM.

Args:
  - page (number): Page number for pagination (default: 1, max 500 items per page)
  - response_format ('json' | 'markdown'): Output format (default: 'json')

Returns:
  Array of events with id, name, start, end, and associated lead/contact.

response_format.description: Output format: 'json' for structured data or 'markdown' for human-readable

name: holded_crm_list_events
title: List Holded Events
